verses.1: For this reason, I, Paul, servant of Christ Jesus, serve you, people of all nations.
verses.2: Have you ever heard of the “economy of grace” that God has given me to you?
verses.3: By its revelation, it became known to me what the mystery was, as I had described it briefly.
verses.4: So that you may be able to understand the meaning of my teachings in the mystery of Christ.
verses.5: What was unknown to other generations about the sons of men, has now been revealed to His holy apostles and prophets through the Holy Spirit.
verses.6: The nations are a community, a unity, and participants in the message of Christ Jesus through the gospel.
verses.7: I became a priest through the gift of God’s grace, given to me through His power.
verses.8: This grace was given to me, the least holy of all saints—to those nations who would preach the unspeakable riches of Christ.
verses.9: And let it be revealed that the economy of that mystery, which has been hidden from time immemorial in God’s presence, is one in which everything is built upon that mystery.
verses.10: So that in this age, through the Church, we may know the wisdom of God, both in its ancient origins and in its present powers.
verses.11: According to the plans of eternity, what Jesus Christ, our Lord, accomplished in him.
verses.12: In whom we have hope and acceptance, through his faith.
verses.13: Therefore, I request that I not be placed among those who suffer in my sorrow, for it is your glory that matters most to you.
verses.14: For this reason, I stretch my knees towards my father.
verses.15: From which all nations on heaven and on earth are named.
verses.16: So that you may be preserved by his glory and power, according to the riches of his fame, through his spirit into human existence.
verses.17: To dwell in Christ through faith in your hearts with love. Be filled with joy and devotion.
verses.18: So that you may understand together with all the saints what is breadth, length, height, and depth.
verses.19: And also to know and love the excessive love that Christ has for knowledge, so that you may fulfill all the fullness of God’s will.
verses.20: But in order to do this with all our might, we must ask for help from God. We believe that it is possible to carry out this task within our own capabilities.
verses.21: To him belongs the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus, for all generations from this age to the ages to come. Amen.
